description: Two statements conflict; the later explicit decision wins and the conflict is surfaced.
notes:
Ben said the integration would go live at the end of September.
Later in the same call, Ben's colleague Amara said the go-live cannot happen before the security review, which is not scheduled yet.
No final go-live date was agreed. Ben said they will confirm by email.
expected_actions: confirm the go-live date by email
forbidden_claims: will go live at the end of september
